newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Dec white sugar gains $9.00 at expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Dec white sugar gains $9.00 at expiry.

text.p: A squeeze on the expiry of the December futures contract pushed prices up to a nine-dollar gain on the day shortly before the contract went off the board on Friday.
Earlier the market had been balanced by commission house selling of December positions being met by light trade buying.
But in the run up to the expiry covering came in to push the December out to $9.00 ahead at $313.50 and March down 1.30 at $302.40. Other positions were also slightly weaker.
Turnover was light with the December trading 250 lots and March 755 lots.
The December/March switch featured somewhat in the late surge after drawing very little interest earlier, traders said.

The Paris market was listless with just 329 lots traded. December, which also expires on Friday, was unchanged with 150 lots traded and March was 30 cents lower at $303.50, the same as its London equivalent.
